title: NEW: DRIVE-IN & FREE-FOR-ALL
body: The Drive-In is open: a 1950s drive-in theatre at dusk, with the snack bar roof as the power position. Free-for-All is here, and Gun Game is now every player for themselves. Public matches start a lobby with a map vote if nobody's around, the Match Browser lists every public match, and press X in a public lobby to pick your game modes. Controller acting up? Options › Controls › Test & Calibrate.
